description: Fixture versions this repo measures against, content-addressed by sha256, with the baselines recorded on each. A bar belongs to a (model, fixture, binary) triple; it is never a constant in a script. Each fixture also records the taxonomy version its labels were adjudicated under — the content digest of labels/definitions_*.yaml at the commit named in taxonomy.commit — so a score stays attributable to a vocabulary even after the taxonomy moves.

gold-2026-07-14.note: Gold corpus as of the technology.filesystem.filename adjudication; 106 columns added and 37 labels re-adjudicated since gold-2026-06-28.

m2v8m-s43/composed-reframe/0.6.53.note: 931 of the fixture's 1037 rows are scored: the 2026-06-22 corpus-pass FTMB does not cover the 106 columns added since.

m2v8m-s43/composed-reframe/0.6.54.note: Composed end-to-end on the 0.6.54 tree, both compact-date leaves range-carrying and the value encoder in half precision: compose_predictions.py runs finetype profile once per column, so this path reads the converted artifact and the on-disk taxonomy.

m2v8m-s43/sense-reframe/0.6.54.note: Standalone Sense, before composition. This path takes branch features precomputed from the FTMB and never opens the value encoder, so it cannot see the half-precision conversion.

gold-2026-06-28.note: Historical: the gold corpus as it stood when the clean-label go/no-go bar was written (git blob at f903a2c). Retained so the bar it carried stays attributable to the ground truth that produced it.

m2v8m-s43/composed-reframe/pre-0.6.41.source: scripts/run_clean_label_retrain.sh at f903a2c; restated in docs/branch-ablation-m2v8m-s43.md
m2v8m-s43/composed-reframe/pre-0.6.41.note: The original hard-coded 0.853. Superseded as a live bar: neither its fixture nor its binary is current.

m2v8m-s43/composed-reframe/0.6.53.note: Same fixture as the pre-0.6.41 bar, current binary: the +11 columns are the 0.6.41/0.6.50/0.6.53 Sharpen typing guards.

m2v8m-s43/composed-reframe/0.6.54.note: The historical fixture, re-measured on the 0.6.54 tree so the pre-0.6.41 bar keeps a current comparator. Materialise the blob with: git show f903a2c:eval/gold/gold_corpus.tsv > output/gold-fixtures/gold_2026-06-28.tsv — the tracked corpus is not touched.

m2v8m-s43/sense-reframe/0.6.54.note: Standalone Sense on the historical fixture. No 0.6.53 counterpart was recorded on this pair, so it carries no delta here; it is recorded so the next release has one.
